text:
maria: FYI onboarding sample app is failing when we enable JSON mode + function-calling. Getting lots of parse errors after retries, looks like the SDK tries to validate partial streamed chunks.

alex: ugh. can you paste the minimal log? streaming+json mode + retries is a rough edge. :grimacing:

maria: paste below — it happens on the first retry after an auth refresh. Notice SDK attempts parse mid-stream:
```
Request -> POST /v1/generate {model: 'rw-4', json_mode: true, functions:[...]}
Response chunk 1: '{"id":"u123","profile":{"name":"Mar'
SDK: try parse -> JSONDecodeError: Expecting value at char 1
Response chunk 2: 'ia","age":30}}'
```

alex: ok that matches what I saw. the streaming layer emits 'data' events and our json-mode validator eagerly tries to run Ajv on any data buffer it gets. if the retry wrapper replays a request the buffer can be reset in a way that looks like a complete JSON to the validator but it's actually a concatenation of two partial attempts.

sophia: we shipped a JS helper in v0.12.3 (`jsonMode.streamGuard()`) that attempts to detect balanced braces before validating, but it doesn't handle retry-replayed streams where chunks from previous attempt are interleaved. seems the auth/retry middleware is reusing the same socket/stream buffer.

jamal: reproducer I used (node):
```
const c = new RWClient({authRefresh: true});
await c.generate({json_mode:true, stream: true}); // trigger auth refresh mid-stream
// you'll see buffer reset + validation error
```
Link: https://git.redwood/devex/repros/jsonmode-retry (private)

alex: short-term fixes:
- SDK: buffer until we detect a full JSON object (brace counting) before Ajv validate
- Server: add a final-chunk marker header `x-rw-final-chunk: 1` for streamed json responses
- Client: add idempotency header `x-rw-retry-id` so retry middleware can dedupe concatenated buffers

sophia: long-term: unify behavior across py/js — py-sdk's pydantic validator already waits for a full payload. we need parity tests that simulate auth refresh mid-stream and assert no premature validation. I'll open a test PR.

jamal: can we patch the python helper to accept a len-prefix protocol too? it's easier to make streaming deterministic if we add `content-length` framing for json-mode.

maria: agreed. onboarding docs are blocked until we have a workaround — customers hit this in the sample app. can we get a tiny patch to 0.12.x that makes the validator wait for balanced braces?

alex: I can push a 1-file change to js-sdk today: add a small brace-counter guard around Ajv.validate and a fallback that buffers up to 64kb. will open PR and tag @devex. :+1:

ci-bot: deploy-bot: canary rolling to staging for js-sdk/0.12.4-rc (tests: unit ok, integration pending)

maria: sweet, thx. once PR is up I'll re-run the onboarding flow and attach traces.

alex: small note — we should document this in the JSON-mode troubleshooting section (docs/devex/json-mode.md) so customers don't start adding crude regex parsers.

sophia: filing a parity task in sprint board to add an auth-retry + stream test matrix.

maria: thanks team. ping me when the canary passes and I'll re-run the sample app flow. :eyes:
